social.deletionReceived: Your Facebook data deletion request was received. This receipt does not confirm that your Momelo account or its data has been deleted.
social.deletionUnavailable: This request receipt is unavailable or has expired.
social.emailTitle: Verify an email for your account
social.emailExplanation: Enter an email you can access. We will send a code to verify it before creating your account.
social.emailFailed: Email verification could not continue. Return to sign in and start again; your account has not been created by this step.
social.failed: Sign-in could not be confirmed. You can check the result again or return to sign in.
social.passwordlessGuidance: You can sign in with {provider} without setting a password.
reset.title: Reset password
reset.notice: Request a verification code to replace your password, or use an email code to sign in directly.
reset.revocation: Saving a new password signs out all devices. Sign in again after completion.
reset.success: Your password has been changed and previous sessions have ended. Sign in to continue.
reset.neutralHelp: This reset could not be completed. Try signing in with an email code or restart verification. Assisted account recovery is currently unavailable.
reset.checking: Checking whether your password change completed…
reset.unknown: We could not confirm the outcome. Sign in to check access; this password change will not be submitted again.
form.confirmationFailed: We could not confirm your sign-in. Try confirming again before continuing.
form.existingSignIn: Continue by signing in to the existing account. Your account details have not changed.
form.recoverAccess: Sign in with a code sent to your email. Your existing password stays the same.
form.credentialsRejected: Email or password was not accepted. Try again or use an email code.
form.offerRegistration: Email verified for {email}. Create a new account to continue? You will review and accept the Terms next.
form.stepUnavailable: This step is unavailable. Return to sign in or restart verification.
form.passwordlessGuidance: You can sign in later using a code sent to this email. A password is optional.
form.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
form.registrationNotice: Verify your email first. You will review the Terms and Privacy notice before creating an account.
form.codeSent: A verification code was requested for {email}. Check your inbox and spam folder.
form.expired: This code has expired. Restart to request a new code.
form.name: Display name
form.passwordPolicy: Use {min}–{max} characters. You can paste a password from your password manager.
form.passwordInvalid: Passwords must match and follow the displayed length policy.
form.acceptTerms: I accept the Terms of Service and acknowledge the Privacy notice.
form.alreadyAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
form.restartDescription: This page needs the current verification flow. Restart to receive a new code.
form.failed: We could not complete this step. Try again or restart verification. Your account status has not been confirmed.
form.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again; you can return to sign in.
auth.retryDescription: We could not confirm your sign-in status. Your workspace stays hidden until it is confirmed.
auth.methodsUnavailable: Sign-in is not configured yet. You can still browse the community.
auth.bypassGuidance: Development mode: Login is bypassed. To test Login, set AUTH_DEV_BYPASS_ENABLED=false and restart the server.
mail.subject: Momelo — {purpose}
mail.codeBody:
Your Momelo code for {purpose} is {code}.
Recipient: {recipient}
Expires at: {expiresAt} (UTC).
If you did not request this, ignore this email. Never share this code.
mail.notificationBody:
Momelo security notice: {purpose}.
Recipient: {recipient}
Issued at: {issuedAt} (UTC).
If you did not make this change, return to Momelo and review your account security.
